title: D&D 2024 Temporary Hit Points

amount.description: Current positive buffer. Absence of this component, never zero, represents no Temporary Hit Points.

locator.const: Playing the Game > Damage and Healing > Temporary Hit Points

$comment: Governed by procedure.mechanic.dnd2024.temporary-hit-points. The component is removed when its buffer ends; it never stores a zero amount, duration, grant source, or stacking history.
